sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read

Initially these new churches were made up of only Jews. One of Jesus’ disciples was named Paul. Paul began to take the good news of Jesus to all people. Through Paul and others, God began to draw people from every nation, every tribe, every people, and every language to Himself. These churches met in homes, began studying the teachings of Jesus, and began to worship God in their own ways.
This process has continued in every part of the world up until today. The church will continue to grow and expand until it will finally one day reach the ends of the earth.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Acts 13:1-3
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach

This scripture teaches us how God's grace multiplies. Paul himself had previously persecuted and killed God's people, yet God graciously forgave and transformed him. As the Holy Spirit led Paul to new communities and places, more people believed the gospel through him and received God’s grace. As with God’s promise to Abraham and The Holy Spirit’s ministry through Paul, God’s grace and calling never stops with us; it reaches out through us to bless others.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan

These lessons help us follow the pattern of ministry Paul received from the Holy Spirit. We can also go to those who don't know Jesus, share the gospel, and make disciples using this book or video series. We can establish churches, raise up new leaders, and entrust them to the Lord. To learn more about this pattern, study the next lesson.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Who can you take with you?
Pray
Ask God to prepare the hearts of those we will share with. May many people find salvation in Jesus through our witness!
